description:
Persian calendar
WPF calendar with support for Gregorian and solar calendars
releaseNotes:
### Offline calendar events

- Added CalendarEventConfiguration, CalendarEventServices, options, and a replaceable ICalendarEventProvider.
- Added annual Persian/Gregorian/Hijri/UmAlQura rules, fixed dates, optional explicit clamping, and stable event IDs.
- Included a customizable starter set of 41 Iranian recurring occasions without annual data files or network access.
- Added opt-in event tooltips and a separate day-number highlight across all five themes and four date controls.
- Preserved user DayMetadata, tooltip content/templates, existing indicators, selection, and working-day policies.
- Added cached visible-range resolution, runtime configuration refresh, regression checks, and a runnable demo.

### ClockPicker

- Accept hour-and-minute input without requiring seconds, independently of the display format; omitted seconds and fractions become zero.
- Added ClockPicker, an editable time-of-day picker based on ClockBase with the existing Clock in a popup.
- Reused nullable DateTime SelectedTime, DisplayTime, TimeFormat, two-way selection bindings and clock events.
- Added exact time-text parsing, Persian and Arabic-Indic input digits, validation notifications and optional exceptions.
- Preserved the date and Kind during time editing, with Escape rollback that also preserves bindings.
- Added keyboard navigation, optional confirmation, read-only behavior, template-part customization and UI Automation Value/ExpandCollapse support.
- Integrated all five themes and runtime language switching.
- Added AM/PM designator properties and fallback labels so Clock and ClockPicker remain usable without explicit resource initialization.
- Added a demo, documentation, offscreen tests, native popup integration checks and a five-theme rendered preview.

Reusable date APIs and independently configurable calendar and working-day services.

- Added Persian parsing, exact parsing, formatting, names and digit conversion.
- Added PersianDateTime parsing facade and clock-backed Now snapshot.
- Added immutable PersianDateTimeParts with complete time-of-day precision, Kind and stable yyyy/MM/dd display.
- Added calendar-independent IsBetween and HasExpired comparisons with explicit interval and deadline boundaries.
- Added Persian calendar information, arithmetic, comparisons, component editing, period boundaries, month enumeration and weekday occurrence queries.
- Added focused Persian core, period, comparison, editor, query and range contracts with independently replaceable default services.
- Added half-open ranges for explicit dates and clock-relative periods.
- Added opt-in DateTime extensions with short names for Gregorian period, editing and month-query operations, alongside explicitly named Persian counterparts.
- Added independent GregorianDateTimeConfiguration for optional Gregorian helper services.
- Added direct IsHolidayAsync plus async-only working-day predicates and navigation, with cancellation-token support.
- Added WorkingDayConfiguration to isolate regional/organizational holiday and working-day policy from calendar configuration.
- Added FridayHolidayProvider and overridable DefaultWorkingDayProvider. I/O-backed providers can supply holiday data asynchronously.
- Preserved complete time precision and Kind for component editing, month queries and working-day navigation; no implicit time zone conversion.
- Retained existing WPF controls, DayMetadata and clock integration. This update does not add automatic holiday styling to calendar cells.


### Clock controls

- Separated programmatic display updates from user selection.
- Made `SelectedTime` bindings two-way by default and preserved bindings during user interaction.
- Unified selection updates across hour clicks, AM/PM changes, mouse-wheel input, and hand dragging.
- Preserved the date, `DateTime.Kind`, and fractional seconds when editing time.
- Initialized display time separately for each control instance.
- Updated the displayed text immediately when `TimeFormat` changes.
- Fixed duplicate hour buttons when reapplying templates and preserved the displayed time during template changes.
- Preserved hour-style bindings and refreshed fallback styles when styles change.
- Improved dragging accuracy by calculating angles from the clock hand�s actual pivot.
- Prevented handled wheel events from also scrolling parent content and ignored zero-delta wheel input.

**Behavior compatibility:** Setting `DisplayTime` programmatically updates the display without changing `SelectedTime`. Setting `SelectedTime` synchronizes the display, while user interaction updates both values.


### Calendar controls

- Fixed crashes and missing calendar cells near the minimum and maximum supported dates, including partial months at the Persian calendar boundary.
- Improved date navigation and `Home`/`End` behavior in month, year, and decade views.
- Preserved bindings during date selection, navigation, and display-mode changes.
- Improved synchronization when changing `CustomCulture` or `Language`, including safely clearing `CustomCulture`.
- Fixed template changes resetting the displayed date or implicitly selecting today.
- Fixed duplicate generated cells and stale event handlers when reapplying templates.
- Corrected selection bounds after removing or replacing selected dates.
- Fixed selection notifications becoming inconsistent after a failed range operation.
- Improved mouse-release handling and keyboard support for `AllowSelectBlackedOutDay`.
- Updated the default `FirstDayOfWeek` to follow the active culture while preserving explicit values, bindings, and styles.
- Added `ResetFirstDayOfWeek()` to remove the local setting�including a local binding�and restore the style value or culture default.
- Fixed date formatting corrupting day names, month names, and literal text.

**Formatting compatibility:** Date formats now follow standard .NET formatting rules. Use `%M`, `%d`, or `%y` for individual custom components. Invalid format strings follow .NET validation behavior.



### PersianDatePicker

- Preserved bindings during date selection, text updates, navigation, and popup-state changes.
- Improved validation of invalid dates, calendar-range errors, and oversized numeric input through `DateValidationError`.
- Added support for entering long-format dates and Persian, Arabic, or mixed digits.
- Synchronized formatting, parsing, and the internal calendar when changing culture or `Language`.
- Rejected incompatible calendar transitions while preserving the selected date and previously accepted effective calendar.
- Aligned the default `FirstDayOfWeek` with the active culture while preserving explicit values, bindings, and styles.
- Added `ResetFirstDayOfWeek()` to remove the local setting�including a local binding�and restore the style value or culture default.
- Improved popup and template cleanup, preserved unfinished text during template replacement, and corrected the opening snapshot used by `Escape`.
- Synchronized effective display limits between the picker and its internal calendar.
- Fixed runtime changes between `Short` and `Long` formats unnecessarily reparsing text.
- Validated programmatic `SelectedDate` assignments before updating control state. Invalid assignments still throw, while preserving the previous selection and text.



### Calendar with clock

- Made SelectedDateTime bindings two-way by default and preserved bindings during user interaction.
- Preserved DateTime kind and fractional seconds when combining date and time. Time-only interaction remains pending until a date is selected; clearing the date clears SelectedDateTime.
- Rejected unsupported or blacked-out bound dates through WPF validation while retaining the accepted selection and allowing recovery through later UI input. Invalid unbound assignments throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException.
- Preserved selection and the navigated date during compatible culture changes. Added DateValidationError for incompatible culture transitions, which retain the previously accepted calendar and selection.
- Synchronized effective display dates and display limits with the child calendar. Clearing selection restores the originally requested limits.
- Aligned FirstDayOfWeek defaults with the active culture while preserving explicit values, styles, and bindings. Added ResetFirstDayOfWeek(), which removes the local value or binding.
- Preserved child controls and selection across template changes, including incomplete templates.
- Fixed IsTodayHighlighted, child style/configuration bindings, initialization from theme setters, and virtual selection-change notifications.
- Validated DisplayMode before changing control state.

**Breaking change:** Removed the unused public PersianCalendarWithClock.SelectionModeProperty field. Remove references to this field; the control remains a single-date-and-time selector.

### Additional calendar fix

- Fixed calendar day-button mouse capture remaining active after a handled release, which could consume the first subsequent clock interaction.



### Date and time picker

- Preserved SelectedDateTime and Text bindings during calendar and clock interaction, without losing time precision or DateTime kind while synchronizing selection.
- Parsed typed dates and times using the active culture, with support for Persian and Arabic digits. Invalid text no longer implicitly selects the display date/time.
- Added DateValidationError for invalid text and incompatible culture changes, with ThrowException support. Incompatible culture transitions preserve the previously accepted calendar and selection.
- Rejected unsupported or blacked-out bound SelectedDateTime values through WPF validation before changing picker state. Later valid UI or source updates can recover the binding. Invalid unbound assignments throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException.
- Synchronized CustomCulture, CustomCultureName and Language with formatting, parsing and the popup calendar, including changes before Loaded.
- Synchronized effective display dates and limits with the child calendar. Clearing selection restores the originally requested display limits.
- Made FirstDayOfWeek follow the active culture while preserving explicit values, styles and bindings. Added ResetFirstDayOfWeek(), which removes the local value or binding.
- Made Escape restore the opening selection, including an empty selection. Enter or confirmation closes the popup and keeps the current selection. Selection changes remain immediate; confirmation does not introduce a separate pending-selection transaction.
- Fixed popup/template cleanup, incomplete templates, disabled-state closing, and Enter/Escape handling while focus remains in the text box. Template changes preserve unfinished text without parsing or committing it.
- Fixed initialization from theme setters and prevented child configuration changes from overwriting picker settings.
- Fixed Short/Long display-format changes reparsing text or reporting validation errors. Committed values are reformatted; unfinished text is retained when no selection exists.
- Removed an undefined InputElementErrorTemplate reference from the default style so WPF validation can display normally.

**Breaking change:** Removed the unused public PersianDateTimePicker.SelectionModeProperty field. Remove references to this field; the picker remains a single-date-and-time selector.

### Additional calendar fix

- Avoided repeated out-of-range AddDays exceptions when generating calendar cells near supported date boundaries, while preserving supported cells and hiding unsupported cells.




## Resource Management and Theming

### Improvements
- Added standard WPF default style discovery through `Themes/Generic.xaml`. `InitResources` is no longer required for the default appearance.
- Improved runtime theme switching for existing and newly created controls, including returning to the default theme.
- Preserved consumer-defined styles and the selected language when switching themes.
- Scoped language changes to the owning `InitResources` instance.
- Prevented theme and language dictionaries from accumulating.
- Preserved the selected theme when `App.Resources` is replaced during initialization.
- Fixed `ThemeChangedEventArgs.OldTheme`.
- Added validation for invalid themes, unsupported built-in languages, and theme changes outside the application UI thread.

### Breaking Changes
- `InitResources.OnTheme` is now an event. Use `+=` and `-=` to manage subscriptions; direct assignment and external invocation are no longer supported. The event sender is now `null`.
- `ChangeLanguage` updates only the resources owned by its `InitResources` instance. Merge that instance into the application resources for application-wide language changes.
- Unsupported built-in language codes now throw an exception. Supply `lanAddress` to load a custom language dictionary.
### Deprecations
- The `InitResources(bool noInit)` constructor is obsolete. Use the parameterless constructor.

### Validation
- Successfully built all seven target frameworks.
- Passed 105 runtime assertions on .NET 8 covering default templates, theme switching, resource ownership, style precedence, language preservation, and initialization.




## Expanded calendar support and optional native digits

### Eight supported calendars

The WPF calendar and date picker controls now support:

- Persian
- Gregorian
- Hijri
- UmAlQura
- Hebrew
- Thai Buddhist
- Japanese
- Taiwan

Calendar calculations, formatting, parsing, and navigation consistently use `CustomCulture.DateTimeFormat.Calendar`.

Improvements include support for Hebrew leap years with thirteen selectable months, Japanese era-aware date formatting and chronological navigation, five-digit Thai Buddhist years, and calendar-specific date boundaries.

### Optional native digits

Added `UseNativeDigits` to calendar, date picker, clock, and clock picker controls.

- Display digits using the effective culture’s `NumberFormat.NativeDigits`.
- Apply culture and digit settings to nested controls, including popup calendars and clocks.
- Accept native digit input by normalizing it before parsing.
- Preserve selected values when switching digit display.
- Preserve hidden seconds and fractional precision when committing unchanged clock text.

`UseNativeDigits` defaults to `false` to preserve existing display behavior. Cultures whose native digits are Latin may show no visual difference when the option is enabled.

### Selecting a calendar

`CustomCultureName` selects a culture and its default calendar. To explicitly select another calendar supported by that culture, assign a configured `CultureInfo` to `CustomCulture`:

```csharp
var culture = new CultureInfo("he-IL", false);
culture.DateTimeFormat.Calendar = new HebrewCalendar();

datePicker.CustomCulture = culture;
datePicker.UseNativeDigits = true;
```

### Compatibility and validation

Existing control names and `DateTime`-based selection properties are retained.

Automated regression checks cover calendar navigation, supported boundaries, leap years, Japanese era transitions, date parsing, native digits, and clock behavior. Manual testing was also completed across all eight calendars.
